name: Stalwart Restraint (Mythic)
body:
You may use your prowess equally well to defend or attack.

Prerequisite(s): Stalwart Restraint.

Benefit(s): You can use defensive powers during a rage, or rage powers/bloodrager bloodline powers during a defensive stance. If not otherwise restricted, you can even use defensive and rage/bloodline powers at the same time.
